Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 3
Reason for Mistake: The Planner made a critical error in information synthesis and fact verification. In Step 3, after the WebSurfer provided a source (PMC7120366) that explicitly mentioned "SARS" in its title and metadata, the Planner incorrectly concluded that the disease was "Severe Acute Respiratory Infection (SARI)" instead of the correct "Severe Acute Respiratory Syndrome (SARS)." This error stems from conflating the general category (SARI) with the specific disease name (SARS) and failing to recognize that the source material directly confirmed the specific disease name requested by the user. The Planner prematurely declared the task complete with an inaccurate answer despite having access to a source that contained the correct terminology.
